---
name: Bug report
about: Report incorrect behavior with a synthetic unsigned reproduction
---

## Expected and observed behavior

Include the affected operation, finding code and interval when relevant.

## Reproduction

Provide minimal synthetic unsigned XDR/policy, exact command, exit code and output. Do not include credentials, customer data or funded accounts. For sensitive vulnerabilities use https://github.com/claimplan/claimplan/security/advisories/new instead.

## Environment

Commit/version, Node version, OS, and whether this is CLI, library or local integration harness.

## Evidence

For semantic claims link to the relevant protocol/Core behavior. A pass concerns predicate eligibility only.
